## Summary

Arshaq Hisham is a product and engineering professional based in Saskatoon, SK, Canada.
A decade of building systems where software meets high-stakes domains: ERP consulting at
KPMG, a Nordic EHR at Cambio Software Engineering, a multi-tenant search platform at
Villvay Systems, and now hands-on LLM agent engineering. Product judgment with real
engineering depth — roadmaps and ROI reviews on Monday, Elasticsearch DSL and tRPC on
Tuesday.

- GitHub: https://github.com/arshaqsoul
- Location: Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada
- Education: MSc Advanced Software Engineering, University of Westminster (UK),
  completed 2018 — batch topper; BSc Business Information Technology, Staffordshire

## Where he fits in a workplace

- **The bridge.** Translates business intent into technical decisions and technical
  trade-offs back into business language — roadmaps and ROI reviews on Monday;
  Elasticsearch DSL and tRPC on Tuesday.
- **High-stakes domains.** Best where mistakes are expensive: a clinical EHR serving
  Swedish healthcare, pre-launch QA for banking apps, national-scale ERP programs,
  industrial B2B commerce. Compliance-first by default.
- **Zero → production.** Takes products from blank repo to live customers. ELUX Travels
  was designed, built and shipped solo: 460+ commits over 11 months, in production today.
- **How he works.** Requirements → design → build → measure, with artifacts at every
  step: models and specs stakeholders actually read, code that ships, dashboards that
  prove what happened.

Roles he lands in: Product Owner / PM (platforms, search & AI); AI Engineer (multi-agent
systems); AI × Healthcare product (clinical informatics); Technical Product Owner
(search & data platforms).

## Career timeline

- **2015** — BSc Business Information Technology, Staffordshire University.
- **2018** — MSc Advanced Software Engineering, University of Westminster (UK),
  completed 2018 — batch topper.
- **2016–2018 — KPMG** (Trainee Business Analyst → Business Analyst → Associate
  Consultant). ERP and business process re-engineering consulting across seven sectors
  (government, utilities, banking & finance, insurance, manufacturing, retail/FMCG,
  telecom). Flagship: Ceylon Electricity Board ERP program — AS-IS study across 17
  departments and ~150 processes; FRS workshops; TO-BE designs for procurement,
  inventory, asset and fuel management. End-to-end ERP/core-banking vendor evaluations
  (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft, Ebao, Misys, Temenos). Data migration QA and pre-launch
  assurance for banking and insurance clients (SQL, Excel, IDEA), internet/mobile
  banking apps, a mobile wallet, and a government e-Registrar platform.
- **2019–2022 — Cambio Software Engineering** (Lead Business Analyst, Colombo). Four
  years owning business analysis for the Overview module of COSMIC — one of the Nordic
  region's leading EHRs, serving regional healthcare organizations across Sweden.
  Consolidated patient information, care documentation, charting, operational insights.
  Specified system logic, information structures, interaction sequences and API designs
  to HL7, FHIR, openEHR, SNOMED CT and GDPR, API-first. Design Sprints, human-centered
  design, UML, Figma prototypes, backlog, UAT, release readiness.
- **Dec 2022–present — Villvay Systems** (Product Owner). Product and engineering lead
  on a multi-tenant B2B search platform for Wurth industrial supply companies. Built end
  to end in one Turborepo (~35k lines of TypeScript and Python): Airflow ETL,
  Elasticsearch on Elastic Cloud, Cloudflare Workers edge APIs, Next.js admin console.
  Roadmaps and ROI-focused reviews for global stakeholders; competitive and technology
  analysis; quality metrics, Power BI dashboards, PIM data integrity. Earlier AI R&D:
  OpenAI and Hugging Face integrations, POCs with v0, bolt.new, Claude Code.
- **2024–2025 — ELUX Travels** (founder-built side project, production).
- **2026 — Applied AI: AI App Generator** (personal, flagship).

## Projects

### Villvay Search Platform — Production (at Villvay)

Multi-tenant B2B e-commerce search for Wurth industrial suppliers (Wurth Baer Supply,
Wurth LaCrosse). ~35k lines of TypeScript and Python; 5 tenants × environments isolated
end to end.

- 16-layer progressive relevance cascade from exact SKU to fuzzy, with tier suppression
  at result thresholds.
- Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion across 11 retrievers; ELSER sparse-vector semantic
  fallback computed at ingest (zero query-time inference latency).
- E-commerce linguistics: unit-of-measure synonyms ("5mm" ↔ "5 millimeter"), fraction and
  dimension normalization, SKU punctuation-stripping analyzers, per-account part numbers,
  barcode lookup.
- Zero-code tenant onboarding: config-only; 11 routes and 10 search collections per
  tenant; 3-level base/tenant/environment YAML merge.
- Airflow (CeleryExecutor): one templated DAG generating per-tenant DAGs (6 pipelines ×
  products, categories, brands), 4-hour incremental syncs, 24-hour watermarks, idempotent
  bulk upserts, Redis staged batches.
- Configuration platform: 33 tRPC procedures across 6 routers, Auth0 JWTs with
  tenant/environment claims, draft → preview → promote, calendar versioning, config
  diffing, one-click rollback, R2 audit trails.
- Next.js 15 admin dashboard: 8 pages, 18 typed React Query hooks, drag-and-drop layer
  ordering, synonyms manager with CSV import/export, live search preview.
- Behavioral loop: click/search events power autocomplete suggestions and trending
  searches; per-query telemetry streams via Cloudflare Queues off the request path.

Stack: Elasticsearch, Apache Airflow, Cloudflare Workers, Next.js, tRPC, TypeScript,
Python, Redis, Docker.

### ELUX Travels — Production, live at https://eluxtravels.uk

Multi-region travel booking platform (tours, hotels, flights, cruises) serving UK and
Sri Lankan customers. Designed, built and shipped solo: ~46,000 lines of hand-written
TypeScript, 23 routes, 22 CMS collections, 42 server actions, 460+ commits over an
11-month build.

- TypeScript pnpm + Turborepo monorepo: Next.js App Router frontend + Payload CMS 3
  headless backend, both running as Cloudflare Workers via OpenNext.
- Edge ISR: R2 incremental cache, D1 tag cache, Durable Object cache queue; cross-service
  cache invalidation via signed revalidate requests (CMS edits live within seconds).
- Production data migrated from Neon Postgres to Cloudflare D1 via chunked replay
  scripts; 15 versioned migrations, 9 seed modules.
- End-to-end sales workflow: faceted multi-type travel search, enquiry intake for 4
  request types, block-based quote and itinerary builder with branded quote documents.
- Payments: full, deposit and installment plans with proof-of-payment upload and manual
  verification — bank transfer by design, gateway-ready schema.
- TLD-driven multi-region (.uk → GBP/GB, .lk → LKR/LK): 5 currencies, no client-side
  currency flashing. Google & Apple Sign-In (OAuth 2.0), 5-role RBAC.
- Google Places API enrichment mirrored into R2; Cloudflare Image Resizing via a custom
  next/image loader; transactional email flows; Vitest + Playwright smoke tests.

Stack: Next.js, React, Payload CMS, Cloudflare Workers/D1/R2, TypeScript, Drizzle,
Vitest, Playwright.

### AI App Generator — Personal, 2026

Describe an app in chat; a multi-agent system writes, executes and iterates on full
Next.js apps inside cloud sandboxes with live previews (like a focused v0 or bolt.new).

- Mastra multi-agent pipeline: coding agent plus fragment-title and response agents in a
  typed 4-step workflow (sandbox acquire, history retrieval, agent execution,
  persistence/preview) with Zod-validated step contracts; tool-calling loops of up to 50
  steps.
- E2B sandbox lifecycle management: sandboxes reconnect across user turns; projects
  restored from PostgreSQL into fresh sandboxes on expiry; custom Docker-based Next.js
  sandbox template.
- Long-term agent memory with semantic recall (FastEmbed embeddings in a LibSQL vector
  store), working memory, auto-titled threads; AI tracing via Mastra observability.
- SaaS platform: tRPC end-to-end types, Drizzle ORM on PostgreSQL, Better Auth, Polar
  metered billing, per-user rate limiting and usage quotas.
- Streaming UX on Vercel AI SDK v5: streaming markdown (Streamdown), Shiki code views,
  live sandbox preview panel, generative charts.
- Deliberate stack iterations: Clerk → Better Auth, Prisma → Drizzle, Inngest → Mastra,
  billing → Polar.

Stack: Mastra, E2B, Vercel AI SDK v5, tRPC, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, Docker.

### AI Oncology Capstone — Design study

AI-assisted breast cancer early-detection and diagnostics module designed for the COSMIC
EHR in the Sri Lankan context (done in the Cambio context). A full research → synthesis →
ideation → POC design sprint, aligned to Cambio's roadmap and the EU Ethics Guidelines
for Trustworthy AI.

- Three concepts evaluated through a weighted Harris Profile; selected a CNN
  clinician-assistant concept.
- Measurable AI requirements as design targets: 80%+ detection accuracy, 60% faster
  lab-investigation selection, 70%+ follow-up mammogram adherence, ≤5 minutes screen time
  per 20-minute consultation.
- Clinician-in-the-loop second opinions that discourage over-requisitioning invasive
  tests; anonymized central scan-image repository proposed for AI development.

### webcules-init & adjacent experiments — Prototype

Earlier iteration of the AI app-generation platform, prototyped on the Vercel AI SDK with
Supabase persistence and component-library-aware (shadcn/ui) generation; later rebuilt
into the AI App Generator on Mastra + E2B to add agent memory, sandboxing and
orchestration. Adjacent experiments: tru (workflow automation on Cloudflare's edge stack)
and webcules-ai-platform (intent-to-execution agentic automation concept).

## Skills

- **AI & LLM Engineering** — multi-agent orchestration (Mastra), tool calling with
  Zod-validated I/O schemas, sandboxed execution (E2B), agent memory (semantic recall,
  vector stores), AI observability, streaming UX (Vercel AI SDK v5). LLM APIs: OpenAI,
  Hugging Face, Google Vertex. Retrieval bridge: production search work (ELSER, RRF) is
  retrieval engineering — half of RAG — plus semantic recall over a vector store.
- **Search & Relevance Engineering** — Elasticsearch 8: layered relevance cascades,
  weighted RRF fusion, ELSER at ingest, e-commerce linguistics, disjunctive faceting,
  two-phase retrieval (_msearch/_mget), behavioral analytics loop.
- **Full-Stack Development** — TypeScript (~81k lines across two production platforms),
  Python, SQL; Next.js App Router, React 19, tRPC v11, Payload CMS 3, TanStack Query,
  Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui; Better Auth / Auth0 / OAuth 2.0; Polar billing; transactional
  email.
- **Data Engineering** — Airflow (CeleryExecutor) templated/multi-tenant DAGs, watermark
  incremental sync, idempotent bulk upserts, Redis staging, declarative YAML
  transformation engines, production Postgres→D1 migrations.
- **Cloud & Edge Infrastructure** — Cloudflare Workers, R2, D1, KV, Queues, Durable
  Objects, Image Resizing; OpenNext edge ISR; multi-tenant isolation; GitHub Actions
  deploy pipelines; Docker Compose stacks; Turborepo/pnpm monorepos.
- **Product Management & Business Analysis** — requirements elicitation, UML, user
  stories, FRS, as-is/to-be analysis, Design Sprints, personas, journey maps, backlog
  and UAT, roadmaps, ROI reviews, competitive analysis, Power BI, Google Analytics.
- **Healthcare Informatics** — HL7, FHIR, openEHR, SNOMED CT, GDPR; clinical workflows
  (patient/medication management, care documentation, referrals, scheduling); four years
  of clinical product ownership in a Nordic EHR; responsible-AI design (EU Trustworthy
  AI, clinician-in-the-loop).
- **Consulting & Quality Assurance** — KPMG-grade business process re-engineering, vendor
  evaluations end to end, pre-implementation gap analyses, data migration QA, pre-launch
  QA and go-live recommendations.

## Accuracy note

All quantitative claims above are verified from the actual codebases (line counts,
pipeline counts, tRPC procedures, commits, migrations). Research statistics mentioned in
the oncology capstone are cited as research context, not personal results. Claims
explicitly NOT made: Stripe/card-gateway integration (bank transfer by design), live
GDS/Amadeus connectivity, Kafka/streaming ingestion, Terraform/Kubernetes, custom-trained
ML models (ELSER is a managed model), fine-tuning/RLHF.
